name: Superlines
summary: AI search visibility platform from Finland: tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and other answer engines mention and cite your brand, with prompt tracking, site audits, an MCP server and an API on higher plans.
best_for: marketing teams and agencies in Europe that want to track how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI engines mention and cite their brands, with unlimited seats
skip_if: you need more than 3 answer engines without an Enterprise contract; you want exports or long history on the entry plan; or you need a refund window after the trial
honest_knock: Starter has no data exports and only 1 month of history, and every self-service plan limits you to 3 answer engines. Fees are non-refundable outside a warranty breach, and a paid plan renews automatically unless you give 30 days' written notice. Enterprise prices are not published.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-16 in a browser on superlines.io/pricing, For brands tab, monthly and yearly view, prices shown in euros; the terms say VAT is added where required) Three self-service plans and Enterprise: Starter 79 € a month for 50 tracked prompts and 1 brand, 3 answer engines of your choice and 1 month of history; Pro 199 € a month for 150 prompts, 3 brands, data exports, monthly site audits and 2 months of history; Growth 379 € a month for 300 prompts, 7 brands, API access, weekly site audits, 6 months of history and priority support. Billed yearly the cards show 69 €, 175 € and 333 € a month, labelled Save 12%. Enterprise is custom priced, with up to 10 answer engines, 400+ prompts, unlimited brands, all-time history and SSO/SAML. Every tier lists unlimited seats and every self-service card a 7-day free trial. The agency tab lists the same price points with 5, 10 and 20 client brands. The terms say fees are non-refundable except under the warranty remedy, and paid subscriptions renew automatically unless you give 30 days' written notice.

schema_offer.description: Starter, billed monthly, 50 tracked prompts, 1 brand, 3 answer engines, 1 month history; yearly 69 € a month; Pro 199 € (yearly 175 €) for 150 prompts and 3 brands; Growth 379 € (yearly 333 €) for 300 prompts and 7 brands; Enterprise custom; VAT added where required. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-16.

compare_with.name: Omniseo
compare_with.why: Omniseo is in our dossiers too and also tracks brand visibility in AI answers: its Essentials plan was $89 a month for 4 AI channels and 50 prompts with 5 seats when we read it on 28 September 2026, without CSV or PDF export. Superlines Starter is 79 € a month for 3 engines and 50 prompts with unlimited seats, also without exports; exports start on its Pro plan.
